title: HyperFix: Combinatorial Nonlinear Correction for Task Vector Merging
abstract: arXiv:2608.11499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task vectors enable model merging without joint retraining. In practice, the subset of task vectors to be merged may vary, but many existing methods use scalar tuning for a particular subset, requiring repeated tuning across subsets and restricting task vector merging to linear rescaling. We therefore formulate merging across varying task subsets as a combinatorial correction problem and introduce HyperFix, a lightweight hypernetwork that predicts subset-conditioned nonlinear corrections in weight space. Trained once on singleton, pair, and triple subsets from a task bank, HyperFix generalizes to larger subsets without per-subset optimization. Our local perturbation analysis bounds the residual correction beyond linear merging and motivates learning it from small task updates. Experiments across diverse benchmarks show that HyperFix outperforms existing task vector merging methods while reducing tuning cost.

translated_title: HyperFix：任务向量合并的组合非线性校正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11499v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：任务向量使得无需联合重新训练即可进行模型合并。在实践中，待合并的任务向量子集可能发生变化，但许多现有方法针对特定子集使用标量调优，这需要在不同子集间重复调优，并将任务向量合并限制在线性缩放范围内。因此，我们将跨不同任务子集的合并问题表述为组合校正问题，并引入HyperFix，一种轻量级超网络，用于预测权重空间中基于子集条件的非线性校正。HyperFix仅在任务库中的单任务、双任务和三任务子集上训练一次，即可泛化到更大的子集，而无需针对每个子集进行优化。我们的局部扰动分析界定了超越线性合并的残差校正，并激励从小的任务更新中学习该校正。跨多种基准的实验表明，HyperFix在降低调优成本的同时，优于现有的任务向量合并方法。
tldr: HyperFix提出了一种轻量级超网络，通过组合非线性校正预测不同任务子集的条件修正，一次训练即可泛化至任意大小子集，显著提升任务向量合并性能并降低调优开销。
en_tdlr: HyperFix introduces a lightweight hypernetwork that predicts combinatorial nonlinear corrections for varying task subsets, enabling one-time training to generalize across subsets while improving merging performance and reducing tuning cost.
